checks: Windows static 35/35 and shared 36/36 CTest; UWP binary check passed; host package built without warnings.
result: PASS for this receiver and host: the UWP-built library in a packaged x64 app with Screenbox's capabilities casts an MKV and an MP4 through the HLS remux from brokered StorageFile access (start in about 2.5 s), with controls, subtitles, start positions (after the fix) and a natural end. The certification kit on that package matched D57 (only the AOT runtime in the host executable fails Supported APIs).
not_run: x86 and ARM64 packages, a sleeping receiver from the UWP host, MKVs without Cues through brokered access, other receivers and firmware.
